20261121-chemistry-e3-2.material: Bayan an buɗe murfin kwalbar turare a kusurwar ɗaki, bayan ɗan lokaci ƙamshin turaren ya isa hancin mutumin da yake gefen ɗakin na can. Wace ƙa'idar kimiyya ce ke bayyana wannan al'amari?
20261121-chemistry-e3-2.thinking.0: Bayan an buɗe murfin kwalbar turare a
20261121-chemistry-e3-2.s.s1.prompt: Bayan an buɗe murfin kwalbar turare a kusurwar ɗaki, bayan ɗan lokaci ƙamshin turaren ya isa hancin mutumin da yake gefen ɗakin na can. Wace ƙa'idar kimiyya ce ke bayyana wannan al'amari?

20261118-chemistry-e4.topic: ɗigon ruwa ya bayyana a saman gwangwanin
20261118-chemistry-e4.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin ɗigon ruwa ya bayyana a saman gwangwanin don warware matsalar bincike.
20261118-chemistry-e4.material: Bayan an ɗauko gwangwanin abin sha mai sanyi daga firiji aka bar shi a kan teburi na ɗan lokaci, ɗigon ruwa ya bayyana a saman gwangwanin. Daga ina wannan ɗigon ruwa ya fito?
20261118-chemistry-e4.thinking.0: ɗigon ruwa ya bayyana a saman gwangwanin

20261118-chemistry-e4.s.s1.explain: Tururin ruwa na iska yana haɗuwa da saman gwangwanin mai sanyi, ya rasa zafi, ya zama ɗigon ruwa; wannan al'amari ne na 'condensation' (liquefaction).
20261118-chemistry-e4.s.s1.hint.0: Akwai tururin ruwa da ba a gani koyaushe a cikin iska.
20261118-chemistry-e4.s.s1.hint.1: Idan tururin ruwa ya haɗu da wuri mai sanyi, yana sanyi ya zama ɗigon ruwa (condensation).
20261118-chemistry-e4.s.s1.o.o0: Tururin ruwa na iska, wanda gas ne, ya taɓa gwangwanin mai sanyi ya zama ruwa ta condensation
20261118-chemistry-e4.s.s1.o.o1: Abin sha ya malalo waje ta bangon aluminium na gwangwanin
20261118-chemistry-e4.s.s1.o.o2: Ɗigon ruwa ne daga fentin da ya narke a saman gwangwanin
20261118-chemistry-e4.s.s1.o.o3: Ruwan itace ne da ya fito daga katakon teburin

20261121-chemistry-e4-1.s.s1.prompt: Menene ainihin dalilin kimiyya na 'fashewar bututun ruwa' da yake faruwa idan bututun ruwa na waje ya daskare ya fashe saboda tsananin sanyi na hunturu?

20261121-chemistry-e4-2.s.s1.prompt: Wane ne daidai bayanin bambancin tsakanin 'evaporation' da 'boiling' idan ana zafafa ruwa a tukunya?
20261121-chemistry-e4-2.s.s1.explain: Evaporation al'amari ne da ƙwayoyin saman ruwa suke zama gas ko da a ƙasa da wurin tafasa; boiling kuwa al'amari ne da ruwa ya kai wurin tafasa kuma yake zama gas sosai ba a saman kawai ba har ma a cikinsa gaba ɗaya.
20261121-chemistry-e4-2.s.s1.hint.0: Bushewar kayan wanki evaporation ne da yake faruwa a hankali a saman ko da a ƙarancin zafi.
20261121-chemistry-e4-2.s.s1.hint.1: Tafasar ruwa sosai a 100 digiri boiling ne, inda kumfa ke fashewa daga ciki ma.

20261121-chemistry-e4-2.s.s1.o.o1: Evaporation yana faruwa a 100℃ kawai, boiling kuwa yana faruwa a kowane zafi

20261122-chemistry-e4-1.title: Canjin yanayi mai zurfi
20261122-chemistry-e4-1.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin Canjin yanayi mai zurfi don warware matsalar bincike.
20261122-chemistry-e4-1.material: [Canjin yanayi mai zurfi] An saka ruwa a cikin beaker aka zafafa shi har ya fara tafasa sosai. Ko da an ƙara ƙarfin wutar ana ci gaba da zafafawa, karatun thermometer ba ya sake tashi sama da 100℃. Menene dalili?
20261122-chemistry-e4-1.s.s1.prompt: [Canjin yanayi mai zurfi] An saka ruwa a cikin beaker aka zafafa shi har ya fara tafasa sosai. Ko da an ƙara ƙarfin wutar ana ci gaba da zafafawa, karatun thermometer ba ya sake tashi sama da 100℃. Menene dalili?
20261122-chemistry-e4-1.s.s1.explain: Idan tsattsauran ruwa yana tafasa, zafin da ake bayarwa gaba ɗaya yana ɗauka wajen karya jan hankalin ƙwayoyi da canzawa zuwa gas (heat of vaporization); don haka zafi yana tsayawa daidai har sai dukkan ruwan ya zama tururi.
20261122-chemistry-e4-1.s.s1.hint.0: Yayin da yanayi yake canzawa, zafin abu yana tsayawa daidai.
20261122-chemistry-e4-1.s.s1.hint.1: Ana kiran wannan 'latent heat' (heat of vaporization).
20261122-chemistry-e4-1.s.s1.o.o0: Saboda zafin da ake bayarwa ba ya ƙara zafin ruwa, sai dai ana amfani da shi gaba ɗaya wajen canjin yanayin ruwa zuwa tururi (heat of vaporization)
20261122-chemistry-e4-1.s.s1.o.o1: Saboda thermometer yana lalacewa sama da digiri 100
20261122-chemistry-e4-1.s.s1.o.o2: Saboda ruwa ba zai iya ɗaukar zafi ba kuma

20261122-chemistry-e4-2.title: Wane ne ya haɗa daidai tsarin canjin
20261122-chemistry-e4-2.topic: Wane ne ya haɗa daidai tsarin canjin
20261122-chemistry-e4-2.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin Wane ne ya haɗa daidai tsarin canjin don warware matsalar bincike.
20261122-chemistry-e4-2.material: Wane ne ya haɗa daidai tsarin canjin yanayi na 'raɓa' mai tsabta da ke manne a ganyen ciyawa da safe da 'dusar ƙanƙara/sanyi (frost)' fari da ke kan tagogi ko rufi a daren ƙarshen kaka?
20261122-chemistry-e4-2.thinking.0: Wane ne ya haɗa daidai tsarin canjin
20261122-chemistry-e4-2.s.s1.prompt: Wane ne ya haɗa daidai tsarin canjin yanayi na 'raɓa' mai tsabta da ke manne a ganyen ciyawa da safe da 'dusar ƙanƙara/sanyi (frost)' fari da ke kan tagogi ko rufi a daren ƙarshen kaka?
20261122-chemistry-e4-2.s.s1.explain: Raɓa tana faruwa ne lokacin da tururin iska ya yi condensation a saman ganyen ciyawa da ya yi sanyi cikin dare; frost kuwa shi ne tururi yana zama lu'ulu'un kankara kai tsaye ba tare da wucewa ta ruwa ba a zafin ƙasa da sifili (sublimation na daskarewa).
20261122-chemistry-e4-2.s.s1.hint.1: Frost lu'ulu'un kankara ne da suka samu a zafin ƙasa da sifili (tururi → mai ƙarfi).
20261122-chemistry-e4-2.s.s1.o.o0: Raɓa: tururi yana zama ɗigon ruwa (liquefaction) / frost: tururi yana zama lu'ulu'un kankara kai tsaye (sublimation)
20261122-chemistry-e4-2.s.s1.o.o1: Raɓa: kankara tana narkewa (melting) / frost: ruwa yana tafasa (vaporization)
20261122-chemistry-e4-2.s.s1.o.o2: Raɓa da frost duka ruwa ne da ya ƙafe zuwa tururi
20261122-chemistry-e4-2.s.s1.o.o3: Raɓa: ruwan ɗimbin da ya fito daga ƙasa / frost: dusar ƙanƙara da ta sauko daga sama
